name: vca_container_exit_@ENV@
description: venue-call-agent (@SERVICE@): Cloud Run's own system log reports an error for an instance (a non-zero exit, a failed startup probe). Repeats in a short window are a crash loop.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="@SERVICE@" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/varlog/system") AND (severity>=ERROR OR textPayload=~"Container called exit\([1-9][0-9]*\)")
